The surrounding unchanged test context was also read. prefixSSDKeyNeverInChildEnvironment (lines 387-439) verifies that the prefix-SSD key is absent from the rank environment and arguments and travels only on the worker input's second line, bound to epoch and rank. metadataChecks (474-675) checks key-file permissions (owner-only, regular file, not replaced if unusable), redaction of key descriptions, fallback ordering of the key source, and cache-off sending no key. It also checks sync-setting bounds (TTL ceiling 1800, version check, oversized sync refused) and the reclaim logic keeping live plans. These match the T-041 mitigations (the 30-minute TTL cap, the key kept off the environment, the staging reaper) and strengthen coverage. They are tests only, and I found no evidence of weakened controls.
